claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says religious avatars can become egregors through shared faith and imagination.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says they are real only to the believers and their group, not to people whose strong beliefs exclude them.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes perceived reality as relative to each soul's consciousness and knowledge.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She denies that reality as experienced is the ultimate truth.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says religious beliefs can be used to shape a group's existential realm through perception and mind control.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes this design and control to Earth's Matrix rulers.
